{{Quote|Theed is a beautiful city.''"<br />"''If you like museums.|Hego Damask and Palpatine|<ref name="SWDP" />}}
The Royal City<ref>[[The Official Star Wars Fact File Galaxy Chart]]</ref> of '''Theed''' was the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. Originally a farming village, the city was formally founded circa [[832 BBY/Legends|832 BBY]] when [[King/Legends|King]] [[Jafan/Legends|Jafan]] established the city as the planetary capital after [[Great Time of Peace/Legends|uniting]] the planet's numerous city-states following a long [[Time of Suffering/Legends|civil war]]. Located on a sheer cliff over a vast floodplain, the city was home to the [[Royal House of Naboo/Legends|Royal House of Naboo's]] [[Theed Royal Palace/Legends|Royal Palace]] and the [[Royal House of Learning/Legends|Royal House of Learning]].

==History==
===Founding===
[[File:Theed_at_sunset.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Theed at dusk in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]]]
The city of Theed began as a [[Farm/Legends|farming]] village, established by the local [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] along the fertile banks of the [[Solleu River/Legends|Solleu River]]. The area, criss-crossed by the river's many tributaries, was suitable to permanent construction and quickly grew in numbers. When [[King/Legends|King]] [[Jafan/Legends|Jafan]] [[Great Time of Peace/Legends|unified]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] many warring city-states, he established his capital on the steppelands, which by that time had been densely populated by settlers who had fled the bloody [[Time of Suffering/Legends|civil war]] Jafan had ended.<ref name="SWCL" />

As a result of Jafan's unification and the strict planning regimes and extensive rebuilding projects undertaken after the upheavals, the city took on a unified and harmonious [[Classical Naboo style/Legends|architectural style]] of [[Sandstone/Legends|sandstone]]-like block buildings with green shingles on the roofs. A series of underground tunnels were built in the city's porous surface, all of which were meticulously maintained for generations. The sophisticated culture which emerged was suitable to the cultivation of politicians and statesmen, all of whom trained and studied the art of [[Politics/Legends|politics]] and public service in the city's many fine [[University/Legends|universities]].<ref name="SWCL" />

===Elected monarchy===
[[File:TheedAttack.png|thumb|right|300px|Theed is occupied by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]].]]
Following a long reign by a hereditary dynasty, the [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Monarch of Naboo]] became an elected official, and the world prospered. Theed had lost all vestiges of its simple past and instead bred generations of a leisure class which enhanced the city's arts and education, erecting monuments to rulers and philosophers, building museums and concert halls, and implementing policy to ensure all citizens would serve in the [[Legislative Youth Program/Legends|Legislative Youth Program]] during their years in academia.<ref name="SWCL" /> The city's [[Governor/Legends|governor]] was afforded the [[Princess of Theed|Prince or Princess]] of Theed.

During the reign of [[King/Legends|King]] [[Bon Tapalo/Legends|Bon Tapalo]], Naboo entered a trade agreement with the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] and [[Damask Holdings/Legends|Damask Holdings]], which changed Theed forever. A triple-domed [[Plasma Refinery Complex]] was erected on former parkland, and the Solleu was rerouted to accommodate its footprint. The Federation began [[Mining/Legends|mining]] the [[Plasma/Legends|plasma]] out of the city land, bringing in substantial profits that helped the city expand. In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], friction between the Federation and [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] culminated in an [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invasion]] of the planet and the placement of the city's population in POW camps.<ref name="TPM" /> A [[Neimoidian Throne]] was [[Capture of Theed/Legends|constructed]] in the city as a sign of the occupation.<ref name="SW:GB">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''</ref> When the Queen led her people to [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|victory]], she immediately began reconstruction efforts, seeing the completion of the massive [[Theed Spaceport/Legends|Theed Spaceport]] and the [[Palace Courtyard/Legends|Palace Courtyard]] before the end of her term.

As the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]] began to take hold in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]], the beloved former queen was appointed [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] of the [[Chommell sector/Legends|Chommell sector]]. During this time, Queen [[Jamillia/Legends|Jamillia]] opened the city to refugees fleeing secessionist worlds that began joining the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. As the world's populace became more restless, protests by disgruntled [[Spice/Legends|spice]] miners began to disrupt local life.<ref name="AOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref>

===Clone Wars===
[[File:TheedInvasion.png|thumb|left|250px|Theed under attack by the Separatist Droid Army during the Clone Wars]]
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the Confederacy, which began in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> a bazaar was held on the outskirts of Theed. Many were in attendance, including Senator Amidala and a reclusive [[Unidentified Naboo artist|artist]], who caught the gaze of the senator and became overwhelmed with visions of her and her unborn twins. Twenty-four weeks later, Theed was [[Attack on Theed|attacked]] by the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]], including B1 battle droids and an [[OG-9 homing spider droid/Legends|OG-9 homing spider droid]]. Amidala was in the city at the time and attempted to escape, which she did through the help of the [[Artist/Legends|artist]], who, having had an epiphany through his visions, saved her life by taking [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]]-fire meant for her. The artist survived his injuries.<ref name="Artist">{{StoryCite|story=The Artist of Naboo|book=Star Wars: Visionaries}}</ref>

In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="Annual">''[[Star Wars Annual 2011]]'' places the [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|Battle of Christophsis]] in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]]. The events in the episode take place after the battle.</ref> [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] returned to the city for the annual [[Festival of Light/Legends|Festival of Light]]. He was the victim of a [[Plan to kidnap Chancellor Palpatine/Legends|kidnapping attempt]], although he was rescued by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]].<ref name="CoN">{{TCW|Crisis on Naboo}}</ref>

===Imperial era===
[[File:Theed.png|thumb|right|300px|Inhabitants celebrate the death of Emperor Palpatine.]]
The Clone Wars ended abruptly in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], and the citizens of Naboo were shocked when [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan's]] [[Senator/Legends|senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]] arrived in Theed with the body of the beloved Senator Amidala. Apparently Amidala had been [[Death/Legends|killed]] by a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] during the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order's]] uprising against the Republic, but the story was simply a fabrication by Naboo native Supreme Chancellor Palpatine. After the [[Padmé Amidala's funeral/Legends|funeral]] of the former queen, self-declared [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] Palpatine of the newly formed [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] kept heavy scrutiny on Queen [[Apailana/Legends|Apailana]].<ref name="DON" />

Not long after the Empire rose to power, a [[Uprising in Theed|battle]] erupted in the city when the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] and several [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]] attacked the newly built Imperial garrison in the city, bent on stopping [[Grand Inquisitor/Legends|Grand Inquisitor]] [[Malorum]] from learning the secret of the birth of Amidala's [[Twin/Legends|twins]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Skywalker]]. Ultimately, ex-Jedi [[Ferus Olin]] confronted Malorum and killed him in Theed's Plasma Refinery Complex, resulting in the retreat and destruction of the Imperial squadron. Afterwards the [[Theed Hangar/Legends|Theed Hangar]], being used by the Imperials to store illegal explosives, was destroyed by Olin; consequently, Naboo escaped serious punishment by the Empire, which didn't wish to draw attention to the fact that they were breaking the law.<ref name="DON" />

The Empire did not stay quiet, though. As evidence emerged that Apailana had opened Theed to [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] survivors, an Imperial [[Battle of Naboo (Imperial Period)|assault]] led by the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] stormed the city intent on eliminating Queen Apailana and the several fugitive Jedi her court had been harboring. The [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] swiftly occupied the city and slew the Queen and her Jedi protectors.<ref name="BII">''[[Star Wars: Battlefront II]]''</ref> To ensure that the next monarch would toe the line, the Empire installed [[Kylantha]] as the next queen and promoted the loyal [[Quarsh Panaka/Legends|Quarsh Panaka]] to [[Moff/Legends|Moff]]. Because Naboo was Palpatine's homeworld, and Theed in particular the Emperor's hometown, it also heavily celebrated [[Empire Day/Legends|Empire Day]], during which the Imperial Executor, Darth Vader, frequently visited the city to give a speech about the founding of the Empire as well as present medals to Imperial officers. In addition, Imperial military parades occurred on the streets of the city for the holiday with statues of Palpatine being raised.<ref name="SWG" /> After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Theed was victim of a [[Terrorist attack in Theed|terrorist attack]] committed by the [[Mummers]].<ref name="SWG:HwtaotTa">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=class|Legacy|Help with the aftermath of the Terrorist attack|Naboo}}</ref>

Theed remained the capital of Naboo even during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], and was [[Rally on Naboo/Legends|wrested]] from Imperial control after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]] by citizens tired of Imperial control.<ref name="ROTJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref> A game which originated in the city, called [[Theed quoits/Legends|Theed quoits]], was still played in [[41 ABY]] by [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]] of the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]].<ref name="Legacy of the Force: Revelation">''[[Legacy of the Force: Revelation]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TheedMap.jpg|thumb|Map of Theed with details on the location of events during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], as shown in ''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Episode I]]'']]
Shots of Theed in the updated version of [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']] are edited versions of shots used in [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']]. However, rather than re-filming the scene within the CGI models, they simply flipped the frames used earlier. The result is that the city of Theed in Episode VI is a mirrored version of that in Episode I. Shots of Theed in [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']] also display the mirrored version of the city.

A large building labeled "University" in ''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Episode I]]'', published in [[October]] [[2000]], is labeled "Hospital" on a map printed in [[2001]]'s ''[[Secrets of Naboo]]''.

Theed is recorded in Seville, Spain in ''Attack of the Clones''.
